title: [CQ-R09] Validated source snapshot transfer
description:
Objective: Export protected base manifests and actual overlay bytes and reject unsafe imports.

Deliverable: Validated source snapshot transfer. This is task R09 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): R08.
definitionOfDone: Path traversal, symlink escapes and .git/.moe/control-path writes are refused.
Hash identities are derived from transferred bytes, not writer declarations.
No host repo/home/SSH/provider-control filesystem is mounted in guest.
Fresh verification `node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

comments.author: architect-26ba32c3
comments.content: Note for R09's planner (2026-10-25): C02 (task-b23c65b0, the daemon's bounded repository source provider) no longer depends on R09; the operator re-sliced it to run now. C02 treats a full Git COMMIT id as the immutable manifest. It reads committed blobs only, through the hardened openProjectGit envelope, and reports uncommitted/overlay bytes explicitly as unsupported (limitation 'committed-bytes-only'). If R09's exported base manifest or overlay is later meant to feed the daemon provider, either expose it as a commit/tree identity C02 can read, or plan an explicit adapter task. Do not change C02's refusal semantics silently.

comments.author: architect-4c57a52b
comments.content:
Split on 2026-10-26 (architect-4c57a52b; the operator chose this in the REPL). The original row is too big for one 400-LOC task, and its transfer half needs the CQ-R08 bridge, which is still three slices away. Following the epic's M01/C02/R08 pattern, this row keeps its full DoD as the FINAL slice. It depends on:
- CQ-R08 (task-7a77465621dc4d6588d5747394cb0ced), which closes the guest-supervisor chain.
- CQ-R09a (task-491a2d8cff4d45afbdac79539098ebb1, PLANNING). This is the pure host-side import gate, scripts/local-runner/source-snapshot.mjs:
  - it refuses traversal and non-portable paths, control paths, every symlink, and case and ancestor collisions;
  - it derives size and sha256 from a private copy of the transferred bytes and refuses writer-declared identities;
  - its tests are in the new scripts/tests/local-runner-snapshot.test.mjs, registered in CI.
  It touches no R08 file, so it runs in parallel now.

Control paths (operator decision): any segment equal, case-insensitively, to .git, .gitmodules, .moe, .mcp.json, .claude, .codex, .gemini, .grok or .worktrees, at any depth. NTFS and HFS lookalikes are refused through the portability rules.

What remains for this row, to plan after both land. It will likely need a further SPIDR split then.
1. Host export of the PROTECTED base manifest: read-only Git plumbing on a full commit id (ls-tree -r -z, cat-file --batch). Identities are the host's own, computed through source-snapshot.mjs. Also the ACTUAL overlay bytes of the dirty paths. Per the C02 note above: if the base must feed the daemon's repository provider, expose a commit/tree identity C02 can read, or plan an adapter task.
2. Transfer by copy only, over multipass exec stdin or `multipass transfer`, never a mount. Re-check R07's zero-mount boundary evidence around the transfer (DoD 3).
3. Guest side, in guest-supervisor.py after R08: materialize the snapshot into the workspace, and export the candidate overlay back. CQ-R10 owns attempt workspaces and identities, so keep that boundary explicit.
4. Host import: parse the transport into R09a entries and pass every one through validateImport (DoD 1 and 2).

Suggested verification for this row: `node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-snapshot.test.mjs`, a superset of the DoD command.

R09a deliberately refuses ALL symlinks. Permitting contained ones would need base-manifest awareness (writes beneath a base symlink), which CQ-R12 admission must handle in any case.
